title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Announces First Quarter 2023 Earnings Release and Conference Call Dates
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today announced that it will report its first quarter 2023 earnings results on April 27, 2023, after the market closes. The Company’s earnings release and any supplemental information will be posted on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website – www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/ . InvenTrust will host an earnings conference call to discuss the Company’s results and business highlights on Friday, April 28, 2023, at 10:00 a.m. ET. An archive of the webcast will be available on the Company’s website. First Quarter 2023 Earnings Conference Call Date: Friday, April 28, 2023 Time: 10:00 a.m. ET Dial-In Number: 833-470-1428 Access Code: 247294 Webcast Replay Link: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/325130079 About InvenTrust Properties Corp.
